name: usage-limit-claude
description: Claude turn that starts normally, then hits the account's usage limit: a rate_limit_event with status "rejected" (the 429 envelope, recorded at 100% used for the named window) followed by an assistant envelope carrying the top-level error enum "rate_limit" and the result{is_error:true} that closes the turn. Pins the two production surfaces a usage limit lights up from the stdio stream: the provider:usage ring reaching 100% with a reset time, and FailureReasonUsageLimit on the turn's failure meta, which is what parks a workflow run as OutcomeProviderUsageLimited instead of failing it. The durable usagebackoff hold is NOT reachable from here and is not pinned: that ledger is fed only by an HTTP 429 from Anthropic's OAuth usage endpoint, which no wire line can produce.

lines: {"type":"assistant","error":"rate_limit","message":{"id":"msg-${TURN}","role":"assistant","model":"claude-opus-5","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Claude usage limit reached. Your limit will reset later today."}]},"session_id":"${SESSION_ID}"}
{"type":"result","subtype":"success","is_error":true,"result":"Claude usage limit reached. Your limit will reset later today.","session_id":"${SESSION_ID}"}
